To solve the case, they’re joined by Shirayuki, Riko, and Reki from Baskerville, as well as Kinji’s maid Lisa, Aria’s younger sister—the master detective Minuet—and even Nemo, who was once their formidable foe!

Packed with gunfights and romantic intrigue, the new story of the Butei begins now!

220211.description:
Based on the vast sci-fi universe of Cixin Liu’s original work, San Ti Duan Pian Ji: Ping Xing Zhi Jing presents six standalone animated shorts, each with its own distinct style. Expanding new narratives from the original's philosophical allegories, historical gaps, and future extrapolations, the anthology focuses on the choices of human nature in extreme environments while pioneering diverse visual expressions of Chinese sci-fi. Whether questioning the courage to rebuild faith in science or exploring the path forward for civilization through the eyes of ordinary people in a monumental era, these stories further push the boundaries of original Chinese sci-fi.

(Source: BiliBili, translated)

220212.description:
In the sweltering summer of her thirteenth year, Sang Zhi met Duan Jiaxu—a friend of her older brother, Sang Yan. This encounter planted the seeds of admiration and, eventually, a deeper affection. Their relationship—part brotherly, part friendly—infused Sang Zhi’s long, formative years with an extra measure of tenderness, understanding, protection, and companionship. Through this bond, the once naive and awkward girl evolved into a more self-assured and better version of herself. Years later, Sang Zhi fulfilled her wish by enrolling at Yihe University, where she crossed paths with Duan Jiaxu once again. Though he remained as gentle and warm as she remembered, it seemed he was now burdened by many secrets. Now grown, Sang Zhi steps forward—unwavering and resolute—to stand before Duan Jiaxu, offering him support and, in time, his own redemption.

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

220224.description:
The green mountains remain, as the sun sets again and again.

After three years of wandering, Jing Jiu and Zhao Layue return to Shenmo. A new disciple bows before them, and their lineage begins to take shape. Yet Liu Shisui, once their young attendant, is caught in a web of suspicion and cast out of the sect. At the Plum Assembly, a game of chess shocks the world; beneath the snowy plains, undercurrents begin to stir. Wherever the sword points, the green mountains still stand. No drums of war sound in the human world—only peace remains.

(Source: Bilibili TV)
